Pharaoh's repeated refusal (Exod 7:14; 9:2; 10:4) becomes the paradigmatic case of human obstinacy against God. Prophetic literature extends this: Israel 'refused to repent' (Jer 5:3; 8:5), 'refused to know me' (Jer 9:5), 'refused to be ashamed' (Jer 3:3)."
